documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported solid financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, achieving operating income of Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 24,446.00 Lakhs, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB. Management highlighted significant infrastructure expansions, including the board approval for a new 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, and major technological investments such as the inauguration of the Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block. The company also advanced its academic initiatives through its Medical College and Institute of Health Sciences and Research.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the 2025-26 performance was driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB.
demand_outlook.quote: The year 2025-26 continues to exhibit good performance, having posted a 16% growth in revenue against 12% in 2024-25, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB (Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that global healthcare demand continues to rise, driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The Medical College has experienced significant growth in patient intake over the past years.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake.

demand_outlook.claim: There is high demand for admission to the medical school, with all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is exploring opportunities to capitalize on the steady growth of medical travel in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Medical travel is growing steadily in India and the company is exploring various opportunities to capitalise on the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block represents a capital investment of Rs. 120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in medical equipment during the year 2025-26 amounted to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital launched Tamil Nadu's first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system as part of a Rs. 47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The outpatient block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to establish a state-of-the-art neurosciences center, which will be the first of its kind in the region.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology to address medical care gaps in the region.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its solar power capacity by adding a 5 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Equipment investments during FY 2023-24 amounted to ₹ 5,239.02 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the financial year was 15%.
Operating income for FY 2023-24 increased by 19.59% to ₹ 1,21,955.27 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The income from operations for the financial year 2023-24 was ` 1,21,955.27 Lakhs registering an increase of 19.59% over the previous year income of ` 101,974.68 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the year reached ₹ 36,263.68 lakhs compared to ₹ 28,450.10 lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) were ` 36,263.68 Lakhs over the previous year EBITDA of ` 28,450.10 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY 2023-24 was ₹ 17,973.07 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax (PAT) for the year was ` 17,973.07 Lakhs over the PAT of ` 11,576.61 Lakhs in year 2022-23.

margins_costs.claim: The company saved approximately 31% on its annual power bill through solar and wind power practices.
margins_costs.quote: This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill.

margins_costs.claim: A waste management system has helped reduce LPG costs through biogas production.
margins_costs.quote: This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital is a 2000 bed hospital facility.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and purchases wind power to cover nearly 68% of its annual power requirement.
orders_capacity.quote: In line with this concept, your company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and purchases wind-generated power, covering nearly 68% of the annual power requirement.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added a further 5 MW solar power plant to expand its capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

orders_capacity.claim: The Sulur branch has added cath lab and MRI facilities to its newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities.
orders_capacity.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 15 per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend.
The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹ 10 per share for FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100%) for the Financial Year 2023-24 for approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend on equity shares will involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ` 1094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not propose to transfer any profits to reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company does not propose to transfer any amount out of the profit to reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not entered into any one-time settlements with banks or financial institutions.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not done any one time settlement with any Bank or Financial Institutions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges such as stringent regulatory compliance, seamless technology integration, and uninterrupted round-the-clock operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue that impacts the ability to deliver quality care.
risks_headwinds.quote: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue in the healthcare industry, impacting institutions like KMCH and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Regulatory requirements present significant challenges to the healthcare industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Regulatory requirements present significant challenges to the healthcare industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Compliance costs, administrative burdens, and potential legal consequences act as a deterrent and demand substantial investments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Compliance costs, administrative burdens, lengthy approval processes, and potential legal consequences for non-compliance all work as a deterrent to the organization, demanding substantial investments of time and money to meet the legal requirements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Attracting and retaining qualified medical professionals requires significant investments, putting pressure on cash flow.
risks_headwinds.quote: Significant investments are required to attract and retain qualified medical professionals, technicians, and skilled medical staff which has put pressure on our cash flow.

management_commitments.claim: Work on the construction of the 300-bed Paediatric Hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the outpatient block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The company is in the process of registering its lease agreements.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is in the process of registering the Lease Agreements.

management_commitments.claim: The company is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology.
management_commitments.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.
